data.name: Ride-By Attack (Mythic)
data.description: You can make multiple attacks as you ride past your enemies. When you successfully strike an opponent as part of a Ride-By Attack, you can continue to make attacks against successive targets. You can make up to additional attacks, but you can't make more attacks than you could if you were making a full attack. Successive attacks use the lower bonus for multiple attacks, as when making a full attack. You must move at least 10 feet between each attack.
